violation_type.title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements (26 TAC §746.3311(d))
violation_type.short_title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS Investigation, there is enough evidence to show that the operation did not have written instructions from a healthcare professional for a child with a special diet due to a disability.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS Investigation, there is enough evidence to show that the operation did not have written instructions from a healthcare professional for a child with a special diet due to a disability.
Observed a bottle in the infant room filled with a brown protein mixture. Documentation of written consent from a health care professional or dietician was not available upon request.

Based on the information received during the investigation inspection, the operation was found non-compliant in this standard. The caregiver administered nighttime teething tablets without parental or health care professional authorization.
